data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` ticket-comment anchor written at each sub-branch creation; extend the orchestrator's `COMPACTION_RESUME` fence to read the most-recent such comment to recover current sub-branch state.

**Why**: Sprint's analog `WORKTREE_TRACKING:` comments solve the same problem for story branches. Without this, post-compaction commits would land on the session branch (wrong branch) because the orchestrator's in-memory context for current sub-branch is lost on compaction.

**Scope**:
- IN: Each sub-branch creation writes `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: sub_branch=<name> tier=<N> batch=<K> timestamp=<UTC>` ticket comment on the debug session's epic; orchestrator's `COMPACTION_RESUME` fence reads most-recent `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` comment with **exact-prefix match** (not substring/loose) before any commit or fix-bug dispatch; **parser is namespace-isolated** — does not match `WORKTREE_TRACKING:` or any other sprint anchor; regression test for interleaved comment history (debug + sprint comments on the same epic) verifies isolation.
- OUT: Per-mode instruction co-location (S8); leak detection (S9); escalation reconciliation logic (S6).

## Done Definitions

- When complete, each sub-branch creation (Phase F and Phase G) writes a `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: sub_branch=<name> tier=<N> batch=<K> timestamp=<UTC>` ticket comment on the debug session's epic
  ← Satisfies: "Each sub-branch creation writes a DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING ticket comment"
- When complete, the `COMPACTION_RESUME` fence in `debug-everything/SKILL.md` reads the most-recent `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` ticket comment (exact-prefix match, namespace-isolated from sprint anchors) before any commit or fix-bug dispatch and recovers the current sub-branch
  ← Satisfies: "COMPACTION_RESUME fence recovers current sub-branch from most-recent comment"
- When complete, regression test demonstrates an interleaved comment history (debug + sprint tracking comments on the same epic) and asserts the parser recovers ONLY the most-recent debug anchor
  ← Satisfies: "Each sub-branch creation writes a DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING ticket comment"
- Unit tests written and passing for the parser and the resume path
  ← Satisfies: "COMPACTION_RESUME fence recovers current sub-branch"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Parser must be exact-prefix; substring matching against other sprint/debug anchors would silently misroute commits on resume
- [Testing] Interleaved-comment regression test is mandatory — covers a real cross-skill collision the blue-team review surfaced

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an orchestrator, sub-branch creation writes a durable ticket-comment anchor so post-compaction resume can recover the current sub-branch
